posts.text: Looks great set of numbers. EPS for H1 is Rs.30. Revenues and profits grew 95% Y-o-Y. Even continue grow on Q-o-Q basis too. In the last management call they clearly said execution would be their top priority, which it seems palying out well. image 1240×511 43.6 KB
